subject: Train-the-Trainer: drop-in schedule + async walkthroughs
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Smith <jamie.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Train-the-Trainer: drop-in schedule + async walkthroughs

Hi Jamie —

Quick handoff from CS to implementation as we prepare the enablement cadence for Acme's first production rollout. My outline below is intended to minimize live time while giving your team the practical touchpoints they asked for. Please confirm attendees for the first two items and whether ACME IT needs a separate security walkthrough.

Proposed deliverables / week 1 plan:
- 30-min Train-the-Trainer kickoff (recorded): overview, roles, and how to run the drop-ins
- Two 45-min practical drop-in lab sessions (Q&A + environment walkthrough) — record both
- Short async walkthrough (10–12 min video) demonstrating service onboarding & config snippets
- Setup checklist + pre-req doc for engineers (we'll validate access ahead of session)

Suggested dates (PT):
- Kickoff: Tue 2027-06-01 10:00–10:30
- Drop-in A: Wed 2027-06-02 11:00–11:45
- Drop-in B: Thu 2027-06-03 11:00–11:45

Attachments: tt-sprint-outline.pdf (agenda + owner matrix), acme-instance-details.csv (instance IDs, region mapping)

Asks for ACME:
1) Confirm the two engineers who will be "trainers" (they'll get the short async video + materials).
2) Verify that the accounts in acme-instance-details.csv are correct and that we have deployment admin access by 2027-06-01.
3) Let us know if security/compliance folks want a separate slot — happy to run a 20-min session.

I'll send calendar invites once we lock attendees. Monica will run the actual drop-ins with me as backup.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Diego: +1 415-555-0134 | diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
